interpretation: Historical beta-on has lower XY and reference-relative beta RMSE in both deployments, but angular jitter does not improve consistently across engines. Different training initialization histories and one checkpoint per condition prevent a causal beta-only claim.
limitation: Reward-off is not a zero-beta reference, feature ablation or measured tire-slip experiment. No flight, height or contact failure gate is introduced.
